name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver selected Task Manager work and derive problem-first strategic explanations from bounded read-only context.

interface.longDescription: Includes two sibling skills. Ship Tasks delivers work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or selected Task Manager scope. A delivery verb alone does not activate it. Every Ship Tasks report gives Strategic Explainer an explicit problem and current facts; the Explainer independently finds bounded read-only strategic context while Ship Tasks retains status and execution-evidence authority.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
Use Strategic Explainer with an explicit problem to find strategic context and explain the current result
